prospective_relative_to_inspection: Written during calibration without inspecting its score panels or final results; motivated by the declared positive expression-gate box
purpose: Separate an instantaneous native-read actuation restriction from a failure of short-path learning
inputs: NATIVE last NEW-pass16 pre-update target tapes from each calibration world; existing expected targets only
method: For every rival compute the maximum target-minus-rival logit gap over independent gates in [0.5,1.5]. A negative upper bound proves the target cannot beat that rival at this fixed saved native read.
not_proved_by_no_negative_bound: Joint feasibility, controller reachability, future native-state feasibility or own-sequence success
other_summaries: Actual native-value norm, actual gate departures from 1 and direct/local teaching-signal magnitudes
